name: Jetwell Computer Co., Ltd.
summary: Jetwell Computer Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing of computers and peripheral equipment in China, Taiwan, and internatinally. It also offers data storage media, printers, office machinery, information software, and telecommunications engineering services. In addition, the company engages in the installation of machinery and computer equipment; wholesale of software products; research, development, and sales of computer hardware; and trading of telecommunications and computer peripheral equipment. Jetwell Computer Co., Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
